group: TSIG.generate(Message, byte[], int, TSIGRecord, boolean) - error handling

cases.expected: initHmac() is called, a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned from the private generate method
cases.description: When error equals NOERROR the condition is true, the HMAC is initialized and the full signature path is exercised with fullSignature=false.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called, a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned from the private generate method
cases.description: When error equals BADTIME the condition is true, the HMAC is initialized and the method is invoked with fullSignature=true.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called, a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned from the private generate method
cases.description: When error equals BADTRUNC the condition is true, the HMAC is initialized even though the payload is empty.

cases.expected: initHmac() is NOT called (hmac argument is null), the private generate method returns a TSIGRecord appropriate for the error (may be null or a record with error code)
cases.description: When error is any value other than NOERROR, BADTIME, or BADTRUNC the condition is false, so initHmac() must not be invoked and the method proceeds with a null Mac.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called, the private generate method throws NullPointerException or handles null Message gracefully (depending on implementation)
cases.description: Edge case: passing null for Message and byte[] should still trigger the same branch decision; the test verifies that the method does not mask the null‑pointer error and that the branch is still exercised.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned whose MAC incorporates the supplied old TSIGRecord (previous MAC is part of the calculation) and error code equals NOERROR
cases.description: When a previous TSIGRecord is supplied together with a NOERROR error, the method must still initialise the HMAC and compute a full signature that chains to the old record.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned; the returned record’s error field is BADTIME and its MAC reflects the old record and the new payload
cases.description: Old TSIGRecord with error BADTIME and fullSignature=true forces the full‑signature path while still initialising the HMAC.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned; error field is BADTRUNC and MAC is computed over the empty payload plus the old record
cases.description: Even with an empty payload the presence of an old TSIGRecord should not prevent HMAC initialisation for BADTRUNC.

cases.expected: initHmac() is NOT called (hmac argument is null); the returned TSIGRecord contains the FORMERR code and does not contain a MAC derived from the old record
cases.description: When the error is not one of the three that trigger HMAC initialisation, the method must skip MAC generation even if an old TSIGRecord is supplied.

group: TSIG.generate - fullSignature variations for each error branch

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned with a full‑length MAC (as fullSignature=true) and error code NOERROR
cases.description: Validate that the fullSignature flag influences the size/contents of the MAC when the error permits HMAC initialisation.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned with a truncated MAC (as fullSignature=false) and error code BADTIME
cases.description: Check that for BADTIME the fullSignature flag is respected and a shorter MAC is produced.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; a non‑null TSIGRecord is returned with a full‑length MAC and error code BADTRUNC
cases.description: Ensure that for BADTRUNC the method can generate a full‑signature MAC when requested.

cases.expected: initHmac() is called; the private generate method handles the null byte array gracefully (treated as zero‑length) and returns a non‑null TSIGRecord with error NOERROR
cases.description: Even when the payload byte array is null, the decision to initialise HMAC depends only on the error code; the method should not throw NPE before reaching the private generate logic.

cases.expected: initHmac() is NOT called; the method returns a TSIGRecord (or null) that reflects the FORMERR error; no NullPointerException is thrown due to the null byte array
cases.description: When HMAC is not required, a null payload must not cause a failure.

cases.expected: initHmac() is NOT called (hmac argument is null); the method returns a TSIGRecord whose error field equals 9999 (or a generic error) and contains no MAC
cases.description: Validate that the method treats any error value outside the three recognised constants as a non‑HMAC path.

cases.expected: initHmac() is NOT called; a TSIGRecord reflecting the negative error code is returned (or null) without MAC computation
cases.description: Test that negative or otherwise invalid error codes still bypass HMAC initialisation.

group: TSIG.generate - initHmac failure due to missing secret key

cases.expected: IllegalStateException (or GeneralSecurityException wrapped in RuntimeException) is thrown because initHmac() cannot be created without a secret key
cases.description: When the TSIG instance has no secret key configured (tsigSecretKey=null) and the error code triggers HMAC initialisation, initHmac() throws an exception which must propagate out of generate().

group: TSIG.generate - initHmac failure due to unsupported algorithm

cases.expected: NoSuchAlgorithmException (or IllegalArgumentException) is thrown when initHmac() attempts to obtain a Mac instance for an unknown algorithm
cases.description: The TSIG object is configured with an algorithm name that the JCE provider does not recognise. generate() should trigger initHmac(), which fails and propagates the exception.

group: TSIG.generate - null Message leads to NullPointerException

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown because the private generate method dereferences the null Message
cases.description: Passing a null Message should cause a NullPointerException when the method attempts to read fields such as the header or question section.

group: TSIG.generate - null payload byte[] with HMAC required

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when the private generate method attempts to process the null byte[] while HMAC is being computed
cases.description: Even though the error code triggers HMAC initialisation, a null payload should cause an NPE during MAC update if the implementation does not guard against null.

group: TSIG.generate - malformed old TSIGRecord (null name) causes IllegalArgumentException

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown because the supplied old TSIGRecord lacks a valid Name (algorithm identifier)
cases.description: When an old TSIGRecord with a null Name is supplied, the generate method should validate the record and reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.
